summary: Frontend-only validation of the BeatCut editor playback mechanics after the FPS/wcPump/CSS-saturate patches in /app/frontend/public/studio.html. Logged in via demo@beatcut.fr, navigated to /studio.html, invoked go('edit/032e4762018d45') and exercised play/pause, CSS saturate filter toggle, timeline scrub, loopBtn, and export modal open. All expected mechanics behaved correctly with zero ReferenceError/TypeError.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.html is a very large monolithic public HTML file (>3500 lines) mixing markup, state, playback loop and export logic. Splitting decode/render/timeline/export into ES modules would drastically improve maintainability, but this is out of scope for this bug fix.
wcPump interval is 20ms (50Hz) — appropriate for decoding cadence, but consider clearing it also on visibilitychange to avoid background CPU when tab hidden.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via React /login page first, THEN navigate to /studio.html — the SPA globals (go, M, togglePlay, wcPump, playing, _fpsN) are only defined once studio.html is loaded. localStorage flag bc_mobtuto_done=1 skips the mobile tutorial. Codec H.264 warnings + a few 401s on /me endpoints are expected in headless env and can be ignored.
